author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Dartmouth volleyball fell to Northeastern in four sets Saturday at the Ellis Rowland Memorial Tournament in Hamilton, New York, but two first-year players delivered career-best performances. The Huskies won 25-21, 25-16, 12-25 and 25-15, dropping the Big Green to 3-2.

Jaida Cekic finished with career highs of six kills, three service aces, three total blocks and 11 points. Audrey Kalorin matched her career best with 12 assists and added three kills. Elle McCreery led Dartmouth with 12.5 points, recording nine kills on .571 hitting and four blocks, while Riley Imamura supplied seven kills and a team-high 10 digs.

Dartmouth out-hit Northeastern .226 to .182 and held an 8-5 edge in blocks. Its best stretch came in the third set, when the Big Green took control early and won by 13 points to extend the match. Northeastern answered in the fourth. Dartmouth remains at the tournament for a Sunday match against host Colgate.
dek: Jaida Cekic and Audrey Kalorin reached personal bests as the Big Green fell in four sets at the Ellis Rowland Memorial Tournament.
headline: Dartmouth freshmen post career highs in loss to Northeastern
